exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) with laparoscopic excision
no symptoms of pretreatment vaginal bleeding
cohort: The study included 49 patients with type III cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSEP) who underwent laparoscopic excision with either HIFU or UAE pretreatment at the Gynecology Department of the Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University from 2014 to 2024.
finding: Both high-intensity focused ultrasound imaging (HIFU) and uterine artery embolization (UAE) with laparoscopic excision are safe and effective for managing type III CSEP, while no symptom of vaginal bleeding and CDFI grade 3 before operation were identified as risk factors for excessive bleeding in laparoscopic excision surgery.
